Delete your account

Close your VVollet account and remove the data in it whenever you choose — in the app, or by asking us directly.

  • No reason required
  • No fee
  • Permanent once complete

Two ways to start

Choose what works for you

01

Delete in the app

Open Settings → Account → Delete account and confirm. Your account and all its data are deleted straight away.

Best if you can still sign in
02

Request by email

Use the email address on your account and we will confirm when the request is complete.

See the email steps ↓

Need a hand?

Request deletion by email

If you no longer have the app, or can’t sign in, ask us by email:

  1. Send an email from the address you use to sign in to VVollet. If you sign in with Google or Apple, use that account’s email address.
  2. Use the subject Delete my account. You don’t need to give a reason.
  3. We reply to confirm that we received it, and again once the deletion is done.

Ready to send your request?

We’ll confirm when we receive it and again once deletion is complete.

support@vvollet.com

We only act on requests sent from the email address on the account, so nobody else can delete your data.

What leaves with you

What gets deleted

Everything linked to your account:

  • your sign-in details and profile, including your name and profile picture;
  • accounts, balances, cash and transactions;
  • budgets, categories, bills and subscriptions;
  • savings goals, debts, money lent or borrowed, and Daret groups;
  • receipt photos and account logos.

We don’t keep any of it. If we are ever legally required to keep a specific record, we will tell you what it is and why in our reply.

Timing

How long it takes

From the app, deletion happens straight away. By email, your account and data are deleted within 30 days of your request. Once deleted, they cannot be recovered. Encrypted backups kept by our hosting provider are overwritten within a further 30 days; deleted data in them is never used or restored.

A quick check first

Before you delete

  • If you want a copy of your data, export it first from Settings → Data & storage in the app.
  • Data saved on your phone is removed when you uninstall the app.
  • If you only want to remove some records, you can delete them in the app instead.

See our privacy policy for what we collect and why.
